# simple-nix-update-gui options

## services\.simple-nix-update-gui\.enable



Whether to enable Simple NixOS update GUI and state daemon\.



*Type:*
boolean



*Default:*

```nix
false
```



*Example:*

```nix
true
```



## services\.simple-nix-update-gui\.package



Package that provides the simple-nix-update-gui executable\.



*Type:*
package



*Default:*

```nix
<derivation simple-nix-update-gui-0.1.0>
```



## services\.simple-nix-update-gui\.autoNotify

Send a desktop notification when an update becomes available\. The GUI sends
it, since only the GUI runs inside the session that owns the tray\.



*Type:*
boolean



*Default:*

```nix
true
```



## services\.simple-nix-update-gui\.busName



Well known name the daemon owns on the session bus\. The GUI is told the same
name, so changing it here needs no change elsewhere\.



*Type:*
string



*Default:*

```nix
"org.simple_nix_update_gui.Daemon"
```



## services\.simple-nix-update-gui\.checkInterval



How often to check for updates\. Used by the daemon’s own interval and by the
GUI’s poll interval\. Supports s, m, h, d\.



*Type:*
string



*Default:*

```nix
"1h"
```



*Example:*

```nix
"30m"
```



## services\.simple-nix-update-gui\.clonePath



Local directory the GUI clones or updates (as the invoking user, before any
sudo) when flakeUri is a git+ URI, then rebuilds from\. $HOME and ~ expand
at runtime to the user running the GUI\.



*Type:*
string



*Default:*

```nix
"$HOME/repos/nix-config"
```



## services\.simple-nix-update-gui\.daemonPackage



Package that provides the simple-nix-update-gui-daemon executable\.



*Type:*
package



*Default:*

```nix
<derivation simple-nix-update-gui-daemon-0.1.0>
```



## services\.simple-nix-update-gui\.flakeUri



Flake URI to check against (any nix flake URI format)\.
Example: github:owner/repo, git+https://github\.com/owner/repo, path:/etc/nixos



*Type:*
string



## services\.simple-nix-update-gui\.systemName



System configuration name to check/update\.
If null, defaults to the current hostname (matching nixos-rebuild --flake behavior)\.



*Type:*
null or string



*Default:*

```nix
null
```



## services\.simple-nix-update-gui\.trayAutostart



Start the tray icon when the desktop session comes up\. Set to false to only
get the launcher entry\.



*Type:*
boolean



*Default:*

```nix
true
```



## services\.simple-nix-update-gui\.useNom



Use nix-output-monitor (nom) for build output in integrated terminal if available\.



*Type:*
boolean



*Default:*

```nix
true
```
